name: pantheon-ai/context-index
description: Regenerates .context/index.yaml from the YAML frontmatter across every .context/**/*.md file, grouped by typology (findings, plans, guides, follow-ups, merge-requests, tickets, decisions, notes, research), and validates that each file carries the required frontmatter fields; use when the index is stale, context files were added or removed, or a pre-commit gate blocks on missing frontmatter.
